title: Customer Compliance Intake Middleware: priority scoring & control-mapping for SOC2/HIPAA/GDPR
creator: Sofia Patel
description: Create a lightweight middleware layer between customer compliance intake forms and our routing/triage engine. The middleware will score requests, map questionnaire clauses to Redwood controls (SOC2, HIPAA, GDPR/DPA), attach suggested SLA and template responses, and surface a clear reviewer view for PM/Trust teams. Goal: reduce manual categorization time by 60% and ensure consistent prioritization for enterprise security asks.
objective: Design and ship an automated scoring and mapping layer that standardizes intake, improves routing accuracy to SME queues, and generates first-draft responses for common questionnaire asks.
background: We receive long-form vendor questionnaires and ad-hoc security asks that are routed inconsistently across teams. Current manual triage causes SLA drift and duplicates work. Existing playbooks (see PM-4812, PM-5721) are human-heavy; this ticket targets the automation gap and control mapping to reduce review load.
proposed_solution: 1) Parser: normalizes incoming questionnaires (PDF/Docx/Forms) into structured clauses. 2) Scoring engine: rule-based + light ML classifier that assigns priority weights (data sensitivity, contract size, regulator scope). 3) Control map: clause -> Redwood control id (SOC2/ISO control, HIPAA safeguard, GDPR article mapping). 4) Templates: auto-generate draft answers and SLA suggestions. 5) Reviewer UI: consolidated view with confidence score, suggested owner, and one-click accept/send.
scope: MVP: web form + email intake path only, support for SOC2, HIPAA, GDPR/DPA mappings, generate draft templates for top 20 frequent questions. Integrations: Confluence template links and GitHub issue creation for escalations.
out_of_scope: Full PDF extraction for multi-language questionnaires, vendor-side portal, automated legal sign-off, automatic change of production controls.
acceptance_criteria: Incoming form submissions are parsed into clause-level items with >85% clause extraction accuracy in our test corpus
Scoring engine produces a priority label (low/medium/high) matching manual reviewer consensus in >=80% of sampled tickets
Control-mapping returns a top-3 candidate mapping for each clause with human-reviewable rationale
Generated draft responses cover at least 70% of the most common vendor questions and can be edited in the reviewer UI
Reviewer can accept the draft answer and trigger a templated response email within the UI
Telemetry emitted for every decision: parse_confidence, score_confidence, mapping_candidates, user_action
success_metrics: Reduce average triage time per ticket from 48h to <18h
Lower manual reviewer effort by 60% (measured in reviewer minutes per ticket)
Increase SLA compliance for enterprise security asks from 72% to 95% within 90 days
Decrease duplicate escalations across Trust and Legal by 40%
rollout_plan: Week 1-2: build parser rules and small training corpus (internal + 50 redacted customer questionnaires)
Week 3: implement scoring heuristics and control mapping table (SOC2, HIPAA, GDPR) and wire telemetry
Week 4: reviewer UI prototype + integration with Confluence templates and Gmail/Sendgrid for templated responses
Week 5: closed beta with Trust team on a shadow mode (suggestions only)
Week 6: iterate on false positives/negatives, then enable auto-suggestions for small set of customers
Post-launch (30d): measure success metrics and expand to PDF extraction and additional compliance frameworks
tasks: Collect and redact 50 historical questionnaires - owner: Customer Success
Define clause taxonomy and canonical control IDs - owner: Trust & Safety
Implement parser + export endpoint - owner: ENG
Prototype scoring rules and ML classifier (lightweight) - owner: Research/Applied ML
Design reviewer UI wireframes - owner: Design
Create Confluence templates for common responses - owner: Legal
Instrument telemetry and dashboards in Console - owner: Observability team
Beta run and collect feedback - owner: PM
decisions: Use a hybrid rule-based + lightweight ML classifier for priority scoring to minimize false positives and keep explainability
Start with SOC2/HIPAA/GDPR mappings only; defer ISO and country-specific regulations to a follow-up
Reviewer UI will live in an internal Console page (no customer-facing portal in MVP)
All generated drafts must record provenance and confidence for auditing
open_questions: What is the minimum acceptable privacy-preserving redaction process for customer-submitted PDFs?
Do we need Legal approval for sending auto-generated answers to customers or only for escalations?
Should we persist clause-level mappings in the customer's workspace for audit trails? (trade-off: storage vs. traceability)
How will Dedicated and Private customers' intake be handled differently due to data residency requirements?
